description: Takes a note off the Ops Summary's Team reference card, as Remove does: note_id. A business with the SOP library keeps the article there; one without it has the note archived, never left active where no one can see it. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: remove_team_reference_note
title: Remove a Team reference note
